name: Restaurant Neuschwanstein
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Restaurant Neuschwanstein in Tirol!** Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, our restaurant offers a unique dining experience with breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. Whether you're craving traditional **Tiroler** specialties or international cuisine, we have something to satisfy every palate. Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—a fluffy, caramelized pancake served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit. Pair it with a glass of crisp **Tiroler** apple juice or a robust local beer. For meat lovers, our **Tiroler Gröstl**—a hearty dish of potatoes, onions, and crispy bacon—is a must-try. And don’t miss our slow-roasted **Tiroler venison** or tender **Almkäse** (mountain cheese) fondue. After your meal, warm up with a **Glühwein** (mulled wine) or a creamy **Kaffee mit Schlag** (coffee with whipped cream) while enjoying the serene mountain atmosphere. **Visit us in Innsbruck**—just a short drive from the stunning **Neuschwanstein Castle**—and let us take you on a culinary journey through the flavors of **Tirol**! **Opening Hours:** Mon–Fri: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM Sat–Sun: 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM **Reservations:** +43 512 123456 | reservierung@neuschwanstein-restaurant.at **Come taste the magic of Tirol!**
